SNACS review rules and exceptions

Annotate each target with scene role and lexical function; they often coincide but preserve construal differences. Use sentence context, not fixed word mappings.

Possessives/genitives: ordinary ownership or association is Possessor;Possessor (your money, my time, their work, address). Possessive before an attribute noun can be Gestalt;Gestalt (my name, my physical address, his fault, its name, their prices, your exact address). A person's relationship can be SocialRel;Gestalt (my friend/daughter, our waitress, customer of mine). A person as source/author can be Originator or Agent;Gestalt as context warrants (your support queries = Originator;Gestalt; your contributions/their service = Agent;Gestalt). Organization framed through members can be Org;Gestalt (Stuart's strategies; my gym); organization as possessor can be OrgMember;Possessor (our business). Evaluate each instance independently.

Of: quantity expression + of + group/item gives QuantityItem;Whole (each/all/four of us/people; some of the best options). After kind/sort/variety, of marks Species;Species. Material is Stuff;Stuff (pieces of wood); content/substance with a noun such as sampler of beers can be Characteristic;Stuff. Emotion/evaluation adjective complements can be Stimulus;Topic (proud of contributions; beware of program). Force behind an event can be Force;Force (rewards of program). Possession idioms such as out of cake can be Possession;Possession.

Time: since can be Time;Time for a temporal anchor (since I visited; since designer is unknown is Explanation). After/at/in/on temporal adjuncts vary by construction: locating relative to an event or calendar/clock point is Time;Time; throughout a span is Duration;Duration; within a bounded amount is Time;Interval. During a session is Time;Time. At all times is Time;Time; for the first time is Frequency;Frequency.

To: destination is Goal;Goal (go to a place, deliver to an address); recipient/addressee of transfer or recommendation is Recipient;Goal (give to a girl; recommend to anyone). Infinitival purpose is Purpose;Purpose (to try, to design). Result endpoint/degree can be Goal;Goal. Paired from...to marking portions of a sequence can be PartPortion with Source and Goal functions.

For: intended use/search complement is Theme;Theme (looking for establishment, need for lawyer); intended purpose/use can be Purpose;Purpose (dinner, for whatever needs); beneficiary is Beneficiary;Beneficiary (options for students). Comparative standard after enough/such/too can be ComparisonRef;ComparisonRef (huge for such a small salon); distinguish purpose construal in context (spaces big enough for a car: ComparisonRef;Purpose). For the first time indicates Frequency. Price is Cost;Cost.

Other patterns: with as verb complement can be Theme;Theme (bother with this, start off with); animate co-participant can be Agent;Ancillary (talk with someone); circumstance accompaniment can be Circumstance;Circumstance. With a set of co-present conditions can be Circumstance. About a subject is Topic;Topic. Because of and causal since/as are Explanation;Explanation. As in a causal clause can be Explanation;Explanation; identity-role as is Identity;Identity. Like comparison is ComparisonRef;ComparisonRef, while a clause complement of look like has Theme role and ComparisonRef function. Of after emotion adjectives is Stimulus;Topic. At/in/on spatial locations are generally Locus;Locus; over to a destination is Goal;Locus; home after motion may be Goal;Locus. Directional back/up can be Direction;Direction; back as location/result depends on context.

Multiword/idiomatic expressions: label the targeted span as a unit when marked that way. Over the phone can be Instrument;Path; in person Circumstance;Locus; in the process of Circumstance;Circumstance; on time Manner;Locus; by far and at all are Extent;Extent. A bare manner phrase such as in a way can be Manner;Manner.

These are example-backed tendencies, not unconditional mappings. Preserve different role and function labels where supported by construal.
